series.name: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)
series.notes: Scoped to the 230 V MultiPlus manual (fw xxxx4xx): 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35. Deliberately NOT merged with victron-quattro-vebus-120v. Two proven differences: (a) code 16 (dongle) is absent from this table entirely; (b) code 24 carries an EXTRA remedy the Quattro table lacks - 'increase lower limit of AC input voltage to 210 VAC (factory setting is 180 VAC)'.

title.en: One phase switched off, this unit off too
title.ur: Ek phase off ho gaya, yeh unit bhi off

meaning.en: The unit is switched off because another phase in the same system has switched off.
meaning.ur: Ye unit is liye off hai kyunke isi system ka koi doosra phase off ho chuka hai.

causes.en: Another phase tripped on low battery, overload or over-temperature
causes.ur: Doosra phase low battery, overload ya zyada temperature par trip kar gaya

causes.en: A slave unit lost DC or VE.Bus communication
causes.ur: Koi slave unit DC ya VE.Bus communication se nikal gaya

solutions.en: Read the LEDs on every unit; the failing phase is the one without code 1.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke LED parhein; kaam kharab karne wala phase woh hai jis par code 1 nahi hai.

solutions.en: Fix the low-battery / overload / temperature cause on that phase first.
solutions.ur: Pehle us phase ka low battery / overload / temperature ka masla theek karein.

solutions.en: Check VE.Bus RJ45 cable seating on all units.
solutions.ur: Sab units par VE.Bus RJ45 cable ki fitting check karein.

title.en: Wrong number of devices found on VE.Bus
title.ur: VE.Bus par ghalat number devices mile

meaning.en: Not all, or more than, the expected devices were found in the system. Often follows code 1.
meaning.ur: System par jitne devices hone chahiye thay un se kam ya zyada milay. Aam tor par code 1 ke baad aata hai.

causes.en: System not properly configured as one parallel / split / three-phase group
causes.ur: System theek se ek parallel / split / three-phase group ki tarah configure nahi

causes.en: Communication cable error between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cable ka error

solutions.en: Check the communication cables, then switch all equipment off and on again.
solutions.ur: Communication cable check karein, phir sab equipment off karke wapas on karein.

solutions.en: Replace hand-crimped RJ45 leads with factory-made patch leads.
solutions.ur: Haath se banaye RJ45 leads ko factory-made patch leads se badal dein.

solutions.en: Reconfigure the system with VE.Bus System Configurator.
solutions.ur: VE.Bus System Configurator se system dobara configure karein.

title.en: No other device detected on the bus
title.ur: Bus par koi doosra device nahi mila

meaning.en: The master is configured for a multi-unit system but finds no other device on the VE.Bus.
meaning.ur: Master multi-unit system ke liye configure hai lekin VE.Bus par koi doosra device nahi milta.

causes.en: VE.Bus communication cable disconnected or faulty
causes.ur: VE.Bus communication cable disconnect ya kharab

causes.en: Slave unit unpowered, so it is not answering on the bus
causes.ur: Slave unit ko power nahi mil raha, is liye woh bus par jawab nahi de raha

solutions.en: Check the VE.Bus communication cables end to end and reseat every RJ45 plug.
solutions.ur: VE.Bus cables dono sifar se check karein aur har RJ45 plug dobara lagaayein.

solutions.en: Measure DC voltage at each unit's battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke battery terminals par DC voltage measure karein.

meaning.en: AC output voltage is too high. AC wiring of a slave unit is commonly responsible.
meaning.ur: AC output voltage bohat zyada hai. Aam tor par kisi slave unit ki AC wiring jawab hai.

causes.en: Slave unit AC wiring not connected properly, or not connected at all
causes.ur: Slave unit ki AC wiring theek se nahi, ya bilkul nahi hai

causes.en: Two AC sources back-feeding each other through the output
causes.ur: Do AC sources output ke zariye aapas mein back-feed kar rahe hain

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC first, then inspect every slave AC-out termination.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir har slave ka AC-out termination dekhein.

solutions.en: Check AC cables for correct phase sequence and lug tightness.
solutions.ur: AC cables ki phase sequence aur lug ki tightness check karein.

solutions.en: Measure AC-out with a true RMS meter and compare to the unit spec.
solutions.ur: True RMS meter se AC-out measure kar ke unit spec se compare karein.

meaning.en: The units could not synchronise their clocks. Typically only visible briefly during a restart.
meaning.ur: Units apne clock sync nahi kar paye. Aam tor par sirf restart ke waqt hi nazar aata hai.

causes.en: Transient during a system restart after another error
causes.ur: Dusre error ke baad restart ke dauran aata hai

causes.en: Communication cable fault on the VE.Bus network
causes.ur: VE.Bus network par communication cable ka fault

solutions.en: Switch all units off one by one, then back on; it usually self-recovers.
solutions.ur: Sab units ek ek kar ke off karein phir wapas on karein; aam tor par khud resolve ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it persists, inspect the VE.Bus communication cables.
solutions.ur: Agar qataar rahe to VE.Bus communication cables check karein.

title.ur: Device data transmit nahi kar sakta

meaning.en: The unit cannot transmit on the VE.Bus network; most likely a short circuit in the communication cable.
meaning.ur: Unit VE.Bus network par transmit nahi kar sakta; aam tor par communication cable mein short hai.

causes.en: Short circuit in the VE.Bus communication cable
causes.ur: VE.Bus communication cable mein short circuit

causes.en: Damaged RJ45 plug or socket, or board component failure
causes.ur: Kharab RJ45 plug ya socket, ya board component ki failure

solutions.en: Power everything down, then check the communication cables for a short.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch band karein, phir communication cables mein short check karein.

solutions.en: Swap in a known-good factory RJ45 lead between the affected units.
solutions.ur: Mutasir units ke darmiyan aik jaani hui factory RJ45 lead lagayein.

solutions.en: Inspect and reseat the female RJ45 sockets on the units.
solutions.ur: Units ke female RJ45 sockets check karke dobara lagaayein.

title.en: Unit took over 'master' role after master failed
title.ur: Master fail hone ke baad unit ne 'master' role le liya

meaning.en: The original master failed, so another device has taken over master status.
meaning.ur: Original master fail ho gaya, is liye kisi doosre device ne master status le liya.

causes.en: The original master unit has failed or lost power
causes.ur: Original master unit fail ho gaya ya power kho gaya

causes.en: Communication cable fault between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cable ka fault

solutions.en: Identify which unit is acting as master and why the original failed.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke kaun sa unit master hai aur original kyun fail hua.

solutions.en: Check the communication cables between all units.
solutions.ur: Sab units ke darmiyan communication cables check karein.

solutions.en: Power down, reseat all RJ45 plugs, then power back up.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, sab RJ45 plugs dobara lagaayein, phir on karein.

title.en: AC overvoltage on the output of a switched-off slave
title.ur: Band slave ke output par AC overvoltage

meaning.en: Voltage is present on the AC output of a unit that should be off.
meaning.ur: Aise unit ke AC output par voltage hai jo band hona chahiye.

causes.en: AC wires accidentally swapped (L and N reversed)
causes.ur: AC wires galti se swap ho gaye (L aur N ulat gaye)

causes.en: Back-feed from another live AC source into the output
causes.ur: Kisi doosre live AC source se output mein back-feed

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC completely before touching any conductor.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi wire ko chhoone se pehle AC aur DC mukammal disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Verify L/N wiring at AC-out on every unit with a continuity tester.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke AC-out par continuity tester se L/N wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Re-tighten the AC-out terminals to the torque stated in the manual.
solutions.ur: AC-out terminals ko manual di gayi torque par dobara tighten karein.

title.en: This unit cannot work as a slave
title.ur: Ye unit slave ki tarah kaam nahi kar sakta

meaning.en: Obsolete or unsuitable model; it cannot serve as a slave in this system. Victron's stated remedy is replacement.
meaning.ur: Purana ya unsuitable model; is system mein slave ki tarah use nahi ho sakta. Victron ka hal naya unit lagana hai.

causes.en: Unit model is obsolete and unsupported as a VE.Bus slave
causes.ur: Unit ka model purana hai aur VE.Bus slave ke tor par support nahi

causes.en: Mismatched models mixed in one multi-unit group
causes.ur: Ek hi multi-unit group mein alag alag models milaye gaye

solutions.en: Read the model number on every unit's nameplate in the group.
solutions.ur: Group ke har unit ka nameplate par model number parhein.

solutions.en: Confirm all units share the same voltage, VA and VE.Bus variant.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sab units ka voltage, VA aur VE.Bus variant same hai.

solutions.en: Replace the obsolete unit with a matching current model, then reconfigure.
solutions.ur: Purane unit ki jagah same current model lagayein, phir dobara configure karein.

title.ur: Switch-over system protection trigger ho gaya

meaning.en: Transfer-switch protection has tripped so the unit will not switch over. This 230 V table adds a remedy the 120 V Quattro table does not have.
meaning.ur: Transfer switch protection trip kar gaya hai is liye unit switch over nahi karega. Ye 230 V table woh hal deta hai jo 120 V Quattro table mein nahi.

causes.en: Transfer switch or relay fault during switch-over
causes.ur: Switch-over ke waqt transfer switch ya relay ka fault

causes.en: AC input voltage sagging slowly, often on a generator supply
causes.ur: AC input voltage dheere dheere gir raha hai, aksar generator supply par

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off, wait for capacitors to discharge, then power on again.
solutions.ur: Sab equipment off karein, capacitor discharge tak intezaar karein, phir on karein.

solutions.en: Reduce heavy AC load that could hold the relay contacts closed.
solutions.ur: Bhaari AC load kam karein jo relay contacts ko band rok sakti hai.

solutions.en: In VEConfigure, raise the lower limit of AC input voltage to 210 VAC (factory default is 180 VAC).
solutions.ur: VEConfigure mein AC input voltage ka lower limit 210 VAC kar dein (factory default 180 VAC hai).

title.ur: Units ke darmiyan firmware incompatible hai

meaning.en: One connected device runs firmware too old to work with this device.
meaning.ur: Kisi connected device ka firmware is device ke saath kaam karne ke liye bohat purana hai.

causes.en: Mixed firmware revisions across the VE.Bus group
causes.ur: VE.Bus group ke units mein alag alag firmware revisions

causes.en: A unit missed a previous firmware update
causes.ur: Kisi unit ka pichla firmware update miss ho gaya

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhoone se pehle sab equipment off karein.

solutions.en: Switch on only the unit reporting the error, then add others one by one.
solutions.ur: Sirf error wala unit on karein, phir baqi ek ek kar ke on karein.

solutions.en: The last unit switched on before the error reappears is the outdated one - update its firmware.
solutions.ur: Error aane se pehle aakhri on kiya gaya unit outdated hai - uska firmware update karein.

meaning.en: An unspecified internal fault that should not occur; a full power cycle normally clears it.
meaning.ur: Ek unspecified internal fault jo hona nahi chahiye; poora power cycle aam tor par saaf kar deta hai.

causes.en: Internal firmware or processor state anomaly
causes.ur: Internal firmware ya processor state mein kami

causes.en: Transient glitch after an abnormal shutdown
causes.ur: Abnormal shutdown ke baad transient glitch

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off and then on again to clear it.
solutions.ur: Sab equipment off karke phir on karein, is se saaf ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Record the LED pattern before power-cycling for support.
solutions.ur: Power cycle se pehle LED pattern note kar lein taake support mein kaam aaye.

solutions.en: If it returns repeatedly, contact Victron Energy with serial and firmware version.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aaye to serial aur firmware version ke saath Victron Energy se rabta karein.
